d: America wants to police the world, project military power and lead the global technology race. But can the world's biggest superpower keep its own infrastructure running? From thousands of grounded flights and ageing air traffic control systems to deteriorating roads, structurally deficient bridges, failing public transport and ageing water pipes, America's infrastructure crisis raises serious questions. The 2025 ASCE report card highlights the scale of the challenge. As Washington spends billions projecting global influence, why are America's basic infrastructure needs still struggling…
